name: Filesystem
description: Filesystem operations within the workspace volume (/workspace paths): read-file (with batch), create-file, edit-file (exact-match + patch-file), navigate (list-files/tree-view/file-info), search (find-files/search-in-files with ripgrep + context), and manage files. Strict /workspace prefix (canonical form shared with mca.teros.bash), path-traversal safe, shell-injection safe, gitignore aware.

changelog.notes: Context prehook (Fase 2): declares a tree-view prehook (depth 2, 200 nodes) so agents with this app installed get a capped project tree injected in their <environment> prompt block (flag prompt.environment-context).

Strict /workspace prefix: paths must start with /workspace (exact segment match) — anything else fails with a Forbidden hint so agents self-correct. Outputs now emit /workspace-prefixed paths so they round-trip with bash. find-files/search-in-files resolve the local root from MCA_VOLUME_MOUNT_PATH || MCA_WORKSPACE_PATH (fixes cross-workspace searches hitting the global /workspace symlink). Admin role support: MCA_FS_ROLE=admin switches to native node:fs over the whole host (dead code since mca.teros.admin.filesystem was retired on 2026-10-19 — pending removal).
Read, write, edit and patch files, browse folders, search by name or content, and manage media and hashes
